newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Avesta Sheffield says to close Wales works.
newsitem.headline: Avesta Sheffield says to close Wales works.

text.p: Swedish/British steel producer Avesta Sheffield AB said on Thursday it was closing down its steel works in Panteg in southern Wales at the end of 1996.
The company said it would shift production from its Welsh unit to British Steel's works at Stocksbridge. British Steel owns 51 percent of Avesta Sheffield.

"(This is) in line with the decision taken by the Avesta Sheffield Board in April 1994 to concentrate group steelmaking at its major melting shops in Sheffield and in Sweden," the company said in a statement.
Earlier this year the company announced the cessation of some operations at the Panteg melting shop but on Thursday is announced all remaining steel making activities would end.
The company said this would result in the loss of 85 jobs.
Avesta Sheffield said its cold rolling business, also located at Panteg with 200 staff, was unaffected.
